types.name: alerts.v1.AlertChannel
types.doc: AlertChannel is where a fired alert is delivered.

values.name: IN_APP
values.doc: The notification inbox on the website and in the app.

values.name: TELEGRAM
values.doc:
A direct message from the Polyester Telegram bot to the Telegram account
 linked to the caller's account.

types.name: alerts.v1.AlertDirection
types.doc:
AlertDirection is the price crossing an alert waits for. Both directions
 include the alert price itself, as stop and take-profit triggers do.

values.name: ABOVE
values.doc: Fires when the price rises to or above the alert price.

values.name: BELOW
values.doc: Fires when the price falls to or below the alert price.

types.name: alerts.v1.AlertPriceSource
types.doc: AlertPriceSource is the price an alert watches.

values.name: LAST_PRICE
values.doc: The market's last traded price.

values.name: INDEX_PRICE
values.doc:
The market's index price: a fair price computed from other venues.
 Available only on markets that have one.

types.name: alerts.v1.AlertStatus
types.doc: AlertStatus is the state of an alert.

values.name: ACTIVE
values.doc: Waiting for its price crossing.

values.name: TRIGGERED
values.doc: Fired once and stopped. UpdateAlert sets it again.

values.name: CANCELLED
values.doc: Cancelled. It never fires again.

types.name: alerts.v1.AlertUpdate
types.doc: AlertUpdate holds the fields UpdateAlert can change.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: New price crossing to wait for.

fields.name: price_ticks
fields.doc: New alert price in quote units scaled by 1e9.

fields.name: channels
fields.doc:
New delivery channels: one to two distinct channels. Replaces the whole
 list.

types.name: alerts.v1.CancelAlertRequest
types.doc: CancelAlertRequest cancels an active alert of the caller.

fields.name: alert_id
fields.doc: Public alert ID.

fields.name: alert
fields.doc: The alert.

types.name: alerts.v1.CreateAlertRequest
types.doc: CreateAlertRequest creates a price alert for the caller.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier; resolve it with GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: Price crossing to wait for.

fields.name: price_source
fields.doc:
Price to watch. Unspecified means INDEX_PRICE on a market that has an
 index price, which is harder to move on a thin market, and LAST_PRICE
 otherwise; the returned alert states the price it watches.

fields.name: price_ticks
fields.doc:
Alert price in quote units scaled by 1e9, for example 90000000000000 for
 90,000.

fields.name: channels
fields.doc: Where to deliver the alert when it fires: one to two distinct channels.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc:
Optional client-chosen key, unique per caller, that makes creating
 idempotent: the same key and request return the alert the first request
 created, in its current state; another request with the same key is
 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. A create key is kept as long as its alert.

fields.name: alert
fields.doc: The alert.

types.name: alerts.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc: ErrorCode identifies a Price Alert API error.

values.name: ALERT_NOT_FOUND
values.doc:
No alert of the caller has this ID. Another account's alert is reported
 the same way.

values.name: UNKNOWN_SYMBOL
values.doc: The market is not listed.

values.name: PRICE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc:
The market has no current price of the requested price source, so the
 alert cannot record the price it starts from. Retry shortly.

values.name: PRICE_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED
values.doc: The market has no index price; use LAST_PRICE.

values.name: ALERT_LIMIT_REACHED
values.doc:
The caller already has the maximum number of active alerts. Cancel one
 first.

values.name: REVISION_CONFLICT
values.doc:
The alert changed after the caller read it: expected_revision is not its
 current revision. Read it again and retry.

values.name: ALERT_CANCELLED
values.doc: The alert was cancelled; it can no longer change.

values.name: ALERT_TRIGGERED
values.doc:
The alert already fired, so there is nothing to cancel. Update it to set
 it again.

values.name: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
values.doc:
The idempotency key was already used with a different request. The
 original alert, or the original update, stands.

values.name: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: A required service is temporarily unavailable; retry the same request.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_KEY_REFUSED
values.doc:
The API key is scoped to a subaccount. Price alerts belong to the root
 account: use a session or an API key of the root account.

values.name: ALERT_UPDATE_LIMIT_REACHED
values.doc:
The alert already holds the maximum number of update idempotency keys
 (1,000), so an update with a new key is refused. Updates without a key,
 and repeats of a stored key, still work; or create a new alert.

types.name: alerts.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc:
ErrorDetail is attached to Price Alert API errors as an error detail of
 type alerts.v1.ErrorDetail.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code.

fields.name: statuses
fields.doc: Return only alerts in these states. Empty returns every state.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Return only alerts on this market. Zero returns every market.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum number of alerts to return: default 50, max 200.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque, keyset-backed and exclusive cursor from a previous response's
 next_page_token. It is bound to the caller, statuses and symbol_id; reuse
 it only with the same values.

types.name: alerts.v1.ListAlertsResponse
types.doc: ListAlertsResponse returns one page of the caller's alerts.

fields.name: alerts
fields.doc: Alerts, newest first.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: alerts.v1.PriceAlert
types.doc:
PriceAlert is one price alert of the caller.

 An alert fires only on a crossing it observes: it records the price when it
 is created or set again (reference_price_ticks), and an alert whose
 condition already holds at that price first waits for the price to move to
 the other side of the alert price. A BELOW alert created while the price is
 already below the alert price therefore fires only after the price rises
 above it and falls back to it. An alert fires at most once; prices that
 arrive late, or a feed that stops updating, never fire it.

fields.name: alert_id
fields.doc: Public alert ID.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier; resolve its symbol with GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: Price crossing the alert waits for.

fields.name: price_source
fields.doc: Price the alert watches.

fields.name: price_ticks
fields.doc: Alert price in quote units scaled by 1e9.

fields.name: reference_price_ticks
fields.doc:
Price of price_source when the alert was created or last set again, in
 quote units scaled by 1e9.

fields.name: armed
fields.doc:
True once the price has been seen on the far side of the alert price, so
 the next crossing fires the alert. False while an alert created past its
 alert price waits for the price to move back.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current state of the alert.

fields.name: channels
fields.doc: Where the alert is delivered when it fires, in ascending enum order.

fields.name: revision
fields.doc:
Revision of the alert, starting at 1. It increases with every change the
 caller makes; pass it as expected_revision to UpdateAlert.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the alert was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the caller last changed the alert.

fields.name: triggered_at
fields.doc: When the alert fired. Omitted unless status is TRIGGERED.

fields.name: triggered_price_ticks
fields.doc:
Price that fired the alert, in quote units scaled by 1e9. Zero unless
 status is TRIGGERED.

types.name: alerts.v1.UpdateAlertRequest
types.doc: UpdateAlertRequest changes an active or triggered alert of the caller.

fields.name: alert_id
fields.doc: Public alert ID.

fields.name: update
fields.doc: New values of the fields update_mask names.

fields.name: update_mask
fields.doc:
Fields of update to apply, by name: direction, price_ticks and channels.
 Required. An empty mask changes no field: it sets a TRIGGERED alert again
 and changes nothing on an ACTIVE one.

fields.name: expected_revision
fields.doc: The alert's current revision, from the last read.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc:
Optional client-chosen key, unique per caller, that makes the update
 idempotent: the same key and request (alert, update and update_mask;
 expected_revision aside) return the alert in its current state and apply
 nothing again, even after it fired or changed since; another request with
 the same key is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. A key is kept as long as its alert,
 so a repeat is recognized however late it comes. An alert keeps at most
 1,000 keys: an update with a new key beyond that is
 ALERT_UPDATE_LIMIT_REACHED.

types.name: alerts.v1.UpdateAlertResponse
types.doc: UpdateAlertResponse returns the alert after the update.

fields.name: alert
fields.doc: The alert. For REPLAYED, the alert as it is now.

fields.name: outcome
fields.doc: What this call did.

types.name: alerts.v1.UpdateOutcome
types.doc:
UpdateOutcome is what an UpdateAlert call did, as decided in the
 transaction that answered it.

values.name: APPLIED
values.doc: This call changed the alert.

values.name: UNCHANGED
values.doc:
This call was processed now and changed nothing: the alert already held
 the requested values.

values.name: REPLAYED
values.doc:
idempotency_key was already used for this request: nothing was applied
 now, and the alert is returned as it is now, which may have fired or
 changed since.
